        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Request</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcureTools</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InstallSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RollOutSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideITSupport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SupportAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Request" name="Request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit IT solution request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Assess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess request for compatibility, cost and resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Assess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assess_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assess_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcureTools" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallSolution" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RollOutSolution" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_TrainingSplit</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_TrainingSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoTraining</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Split" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_ProcureTools">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_ProcureTools" targetRef="Task_InstallSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_InstallSolution" targetRef="Task_TestSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Rollout" sourceRef="Task_TestSolution" targetRef="Task_RollOutSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_TrainingSplit" sourceRef="Task_RollOutSolution" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${trainingRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoTraining" name="No training" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Merge" targetRef="Task_ProvideITSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End" sourceRef="Task_ProvideITSupport" targetRef="EndEvent_SupportAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Requester" name="Requesting Employee or Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Request</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCompatibility</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateCostResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcureTools</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InstallSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RollOutSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideITSupport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SupportAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Request" name="Request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit IT solution request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Compatibility</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckCompatibility" name="Check compatibility with existing systems">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Compatibility</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Compatibility_Cost</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateCostResources" name="Evaluate cost and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Compatibility_Cost</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cost_ApprovalSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cost_ApprovalSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcureTools" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallSolution" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSolution" name="Test solution in controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RollOutSolution" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_TrainingSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Split" name="Training provided?" default="Flow_NoTraining">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_TrainingSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoTraining</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Merge" name="Training path merged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoTraining</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Support</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideITSupport" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Support</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SupportAvailable" name="IT support available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_Request" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Compatibility" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCompatibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compatibility_Cost" sourceRef="Task_CheckCompatibility" targetRef="Task_EvaluateCostResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cost_ApprovalSplit" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateCostResources" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_ProcureTools">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_ProcureTools" targetRef="Task_InstallSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_InstallSolution" targetRef="Task_TestSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Rollout" sourceRef="Task_TestSolution" targetRef="Task_RollOutSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_TrainingSplit" sourceRef="Task_RollOutSolution" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoTraining" name="Training skipped" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Merge" targetRef="Task_ProvideITSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End" sourceRef="Task_ProvideITSupport" targetRef="EndEvent_SupportAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
